text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第1批 · 02 · 夏日别墅早餐露台.
Environment: A richly observed film set with a specific emotional story, original architecture and arrangement, not a replica of a film frame. Vicky aesthetic: luminous high-key exposure with retained highlight detail, cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown, restrained pastel accents, broad soft daylight, filled low shadows, fine natural material texture and wear, very subtle film halation and grain, elegant believable photographic realism. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective, layered foreground/midground/background, gentle depth separation but environment clearly readable. Space reserved at central lower midground for future character compositing. ABSOLUTELY EMPTY ENVIRONMENT: no people, no characters, no animals, birds or insects, no human silhouettes, no human reflections, no hands, no faces on paintings, posters or screens, no statues or mannequins. No logos, watermarks, readable text. Avoid CGI real-estate renders, sterile showrooms, excessive bloom, orange grading, deep black shadows, ultrawide distortion. Scene: a quiet northern Italian country villa's shaded breakfast loggia on a luminous summer morning. Weathered ivory stucco arches, faded sage shutters on one side, pale limestone floor, worn honey-brown small table with an off-white linen cloth, two mismatched cane chairs, two small coffee cups and a bowl of apricots. Camera is beneath the loggia looking diagonally through an arch toward soft orchard greens and a pale gravel footpath. A linen curtain lifted very slightly by breeze, no dramatic sunbeams. Foreground table clipped naturally at left, center clear, distant lawn readable. Beautiful imperfect lived-in villa, restrained material patina. Research inspiration: Call Me by Your Name's inherited lived-in villa and garden, entirely original layout. Emotion: summer intimacy, an unfinished conversation.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第1批 · 02 · 夏日别墅早餐露台. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
